title: Agree — I see your point, and…

examples.everyday: I agree that we should leave early.

options: To refuse to listen to another opinion.
check.explanation: Agree: To have the same opinion. Example: I agree with your suggestion.
check.hint: Think about how "agree" is used in this example: I agree with your suggestion.

explanation.en: Agreeing can be followed by an additional suggestion.
explanation.taglish: Kapag agree ka, pareho kayo ng opinion. Puwede ka ring magdagdag ng suggestion.

meaning.en: To acknowledge someone else's view and build on it.
meaning.taglish: I-acknowledge ang idea at magdagdag ng sarili.
meaning.fil: Pagkilala sa sinabi ng iba bago magdagdag ng idea.

examples.work: I see your point, and I think we should prepare earlier.
examples.everyday: I see your point, and I think leaving early would help.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I see your point, and I think we should prepare earlier.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.text: Agreed. Let's start planning on Monday.

check.prompt: Why say 'I see your point, and…'?
options: To acknowledge and add an idea
check.explanation: To acknowledge someone else's view and build on it. Example: I see your point, and I think we should prepare earlier.
check.hint: Read the complete example aloud: I see your point, and I think we should prepare earlier.

grammarTip.explanation: Use 'and' to add a related idea: 'I agree, and I think we should start earlier.' 'I see your point' means you understand; it does not always mean you agree.

speaking.scenario: A colleague suggests changing a schedule. Agree with part of the idea and add your own.
hints: I see your point, and I'd like to add one suggestion.
Ask a follow-up question or end politely.
speaking.oneMinuteGoal: Introduce your point and support it with one example.
speaking.twoMinuteGoal: Add a second example, a reason, and a friendly closing.
speaking.modelResponse: I see your point, and I agree that we need more time. I also think we should split the work into smaller tasks so everyone can contribute. Would that work for the team?
selfReview: I answered the situation with a clear main message.
I included the detail or question the listener needs.
I chose one sentence to improve or practice again.

durationGuidance.en: One and two minutes are optional practice targets, not minimums. A shorter complete message counts. Start with two or three sentences, then add detail if useful.
durationGuidance.taglish: Optional targets lang ang isa o dalawang minuto. Puwedeng mas maikli basta malinaw ang mensahe. Magsimula sa dalawa o tatlong pangungusap.
durationGuidance.fil: Gabay lamang ang isa o dalawang minuto, hindi kailangang abutin. Sapat ang mas maikling sagot kung malinaw ang mensahe.

speaking.modelResponseNote: This is one short example, not a script to memorize or a timed one-minute answer. Your details and wording may differ.

prompt.taglish: Bago magsalita, subukang alalahanin ang isang expression sa Day 4. Gamitin kung bagay sa situation today; hindi kailangan ng dagdag na recording.
prompt.fil: Bago magsalita, alalahanin ang isang pahayag mula sa Araw 4. Gamitin kung angkop; hindi kailangan ng dagdag na rekording.
